title: 真实搭讪，搭讪甜妹

timeline.summary: A male camera-holder approaches a woman in a busy night-street setting and states that he came over to approach her; the opening ASR is partly garbled.
No reliable ASR text is present for this interval. Sparse frames show the same interaction and phone handling, but do not support reconstructing the missing words or result.
He asks whether the women are visiting; they answer that they are locals, and the interaction ends with goodbye.
The parties separate; sparse frames show no later continuation or outcome.
